gloss: staying at home; home standby; self-quarantine

definitions.gloss: staying at home on standby; remaining at home as instructed
definitions.explanation: Being required or requested to stay at home and wait for further instructions. Used in workplace, school, and public health contexts, including during infectious disease outbreaks and natural disasters.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}のため{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}になった。
examples.english: We were told to stay home because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {濃厚|のうこう}{接触者|せっしょくしゃ}は{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}を{求|もと}められた。
examples.english: Close contacts were asked to stay home and quarantine.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}から{自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}の{指示|しじ}が{出|で}たので、{連絡|れんらく}があるまで{家|いえ}にいる。
examples.english: The company issued a stay-at-home order, so I'll be at home until I hear from them.

notes:
USAGE:
Became very common during the COVID-19 pandemic. Also used when employees are suspended from work pending an investigation, or when schools close due to weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}を{命|めい}じられる (to be ordered to stay home)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}の{指示|しじ} (instruction to stay home)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}{期間|きかん} (home quarantine period)
- {自宅|じたく}{待機|たいき}を{求|もと}める (to request someone stay home)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{自粛|じしゅく}: voluntarily refraining from going out — a request rather than an order
- {自宅|じたく}{療養|りょうよう}: recovering at home — specifically for medical treatment
